Clause reference: reg_nj_ocean_container_permit. Published: 2024-01; accessed: 2026-06-25. archived_evidence_only_not_verified_for_this_trip
Retained source text:
An Ocean Borne Container Permit can be obtained for a truck tractor semitrailer combination engaged in the overweight transportation of sealed containers of the type commonly used for the conveyance of freight transportation in international ocean-going commerce. Moves made under this permit type must be of legal dimensions and are subject to the weight limitations shown in Table 5.
TABLE 5 OCEAN BORNE CONTAINER PERMIT WEIGHT LIMITATIONS: Maximum Gross Weight 90,000 lbs; Maximum Tandem Weight 38,000 lbs; Maximum Tri-axle Weight 56,400 lbs.
Source qualifications: The Table 5 entry is a linearized three-column table, not a continuous verbatim sentence. Gross 90,000 lb, tandem 38,000 lb and tri-axle 56,400 lb values match the PDF. Clause reference: reg_nj_single_trip_osow_permit. Published: 2024-01; accessed: 2026-06-25. archived_evidence_only_not_verified_for_this_trip
Retained source text:
A single-trip permit allows a carrier to haul a non-divisible load above legal size and/or weight limitations and is valid for a single trip within a period of five days. In the event the one-way trip cannot be completed within the valid life of the single-trip permit due to hazardous road conditions or vehicle breakdown, a one-day extension may be granted provided that the request is made to the DOT before the permit has expired. Permit restrictions are assigned based on requested dimensions and weights.
Source qualifications:

archived_observations.source_text: Effective August 3, 2026, a section of Port St. will be reduced to one lane in both directions between Brewster Rd. and Marlin St. until further notice. In this section of Port St., lanes will be reduced to 11 feet wide and all oversize loads heading eastbound on Port St. MUST utilize the Corbin St. ramp. All oversize loads heading westbound on Port St. MUST follow the Marlin St. / Kellogg St. detour or utilize Outer Port St. until further notice. All oversize loads MUST exit through the south via North Ave. Please call the Port Authority Police Department (PAPD) at (973) 578-2180 to request an escort for any oversize loads travelling through the port.
